children: SAID ON FRIDAY IT HAS SIGNED AGREEMENT WITH CREDITOR REGULATING REPAYMENT OF ABOUT 3 MILLION ZLOTYS
BY MAY 31, 2027 PARTIES CAN DECIDE TO CONVERT ALL OR PART OF DEBT INTO SHARES OF COMPANY OR ITS GROUP
IF NO CONVERSION IS AGREED REPAYMENT OF DEBT WILL START IN AUGUST 2027 IN 24 EQUAL MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS
